firstLines: Because apparently a perfectly good Saturday afternoon needed a little more CSAUP, a crew of F3 PAC decided that running, rucking, or lifting heavy things simply wasn’t enough even after a BD this morning.
So we took the fellowship off the pavement and onto the water.
The mission: Sail. Drink in the views. Avoid sinking. And, most importantly, spend an afternoon with the PAX doing something completely unnecessary.
Just wind, water, fellowship, and questionable nautical decision-making.
Our challenge to honor of our fallen brother Gigolo from the FTX/LTX Region has taken hold!  The Chris Walters GIGOLO Memorial Burpee Challenge.

This challenge is designed not just to do burpees, but more importantly to create and complete a meaningful health goal for your life.  We’re focusing on heart health in honor of Gigolo, but it can be anything that you need to do to improve your health in an important way.  The flyer says it all, but here’s a summary:
• Pick a heart health goal that you will complete in the next 12 months (preferably sooner if possible)
• We included some easy heart scan links on the flyer, these are great places to start!
YHC is focused on getting bloodwork done annually and keeping my cholesterol under control through diet, exercise, and vitamins.
• Pick two F3 PAX to challenge. This can be in our AO, but it would be great to branch out into other AO’s and regions.
YHC Challenges LayUp and now that I read the entire post, I'm adding another HIM that has had a significant impact on F3WH.. another man I admire and respect - Bobby Boucher
• Make a video telling about your goal, challenging your brother, then completing 47 burpees.
• Take as long as you need for the burpees. - YHC finished in 2:35 - complete burpee with a full merkin
• Post the video in the comments to this pre-blast. Be sure to tag the two you challenge.
• Encourage, EH and Push your brother to carry the challenge forward to the next man!  Give them #47 hours to complete the challenge!  This is the time for MAXIMUM PEER PRESSURE!!
We’ll push this until every F3 pax has committed to a health goal.  Then we’ll push something similar out on social media to our non-F3 concentrica.
Thanks for your support to push each other inside and outside of the gloom where it really counts!

This is the Backblast for the Coastal Plains Relay for FTX/LTX/West Houston

On the night of July 17th through the day of July 18th 32 HIM traveled the route of the coastal plains relay together and coming together as a team. We pushed each other, we enjoyed some quality fellowship time and we completed the journey together, crossing the finish line as one solid unit. It was a night of ups and downs. The day time brought some heat, but the PAX pushed through to the finish line. I want to thank all of you for your patience, your persistence in pushing each other and for the fellowship time we were all able to enjoy.  I hope you all enjoyed it as much as I did. Looking forward to making it better next year.
What: An overnight Ruck for 76.8 miles in the Coastal Plains Relay.
Why: Not real sure, it's almost insanity. But the feeling of accomplishment is awesome.
Where: the Southeast roads of Texas leading into Surfside Beach
